audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text, wants.you[0], and wants.foe[0] all label Tangle-Barbs as her '(Q)'. It is her E. Her Q is Blooming Burst, a plain-damage seed toss with no CC flags.
audit.why: enemyKit lists Q='Blooming Burst' (cd 9-7, no CC) and E='Tangle-Barbs' (cd 12-10, hardCC root). Calling the root ability '(Q)' would send a reader to save the wrong cooldown for the wrong ability — the same class of error the calibration notes warn about (Cassiopeia's Q/W mixup).
audit.corrected: Swapped '(Q)' to '(E)' in spikes[0].text, wants.you[0], and wants.foe[0], and added Blooming Burst (Q) as the no-CC poke ability in spikes[0].text for clarity.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0..6].side all read the placeholder 'Skill' while content win[0..6] already say 'Lux' for every stage.
audit.why: THE CHART RULE requires full .side and content win[N] to name the same side. win[N] is already correct (matches packet.levelChart: Lux all 7 rows), so only .side needs to move.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no cooldown numbers (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT); dosFull[0].t/[1].t and report[9].t misgender Neeko as 'his/him' (lint MISGENDER); dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad copies under unrelated titles (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED).
audit.why: Neeko is female per champ-gender.js. Tangle-Barbs (E) is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s — a real number makes the sidestep-timing advice concrete; her R (Pop Blossom) knocks up and stuns on landing, which the retitled dosFull[1].d/dontsFull[2].d now state instead of restating generic trade lines.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns cites 12-10s (E); pronouns fixed; dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d rewritten to match their titles.

edits.before: You spike at 2: your Q root out-ranges Neeko's Tangle-Barbs (Q), so poke with E and threaten the all-in before she can set up a Tangle-Barbs root chain on you.
edits.after: You spike at 2: your Q root out-ranges Neeko's Blooming Burst (Q), so poke with E and threaten the all-in before she can land a Tangle-Barbs (E) root chain on you.

edits.before: Poke with E-Q from outside Tangle-Barbs (Q) range
edits.after: Poke with E-Q from outside Tangle-Barbs (E) range

edits.before: Land a full Tangle-Barbs (Q) root chain to lock you for the all-in
edits.after: Land a full Tangle-Barbs (E) root chain to lock you for the all-in

edits.before: E the contact, detonate, passive-auto, bank the Q visibly — the chip is free and the threat governs.
edits.after: Bank W (Barrier) for her Pop Blossom knockup — one cast neutralizes the stun and saves your ADC clean.

edits.before: Q-poking on cooldown until the hook learns the rhythm — the binding is the lane's law; spend it like one.
edits.after: Pop Blossom hits everyone nearby — spread from your ADC so one landing can't stun your whole duo.

edits.before: Commit on Tangle-Barbs (Root)’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Make him flinch first.
edits.after: Commit on Tangle-Barbs (Root)’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Make her flinch first.

edits.before: - Neeko Tangle-Barbs (Root): matchup-defining — The root sets up her whole burst — sidestep it behind minions. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Prismatic Barrier banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: Tangle-Barbs (E) is 12s at rank 1, down to 10s at max — the root that sets up her whole burst; sidestep it behind minions and it's just a slow poke war. Blooming Burst (Q) has no CC, so only the E timing matters. Bank Barrier for after it lands, not before.

notes: Three fields mislabeled Tangle-Barbs (her E, the root) as her Q; her real Q, Blooming Burst, has no CC at all. This is the same class of ability-slot error flagged in the brief's calibration examples and was worth fixing everywhere it appeared.
